regime_context: The detector shows a narrow, absolute-trend-eligible leadership cluster of Semiconductor/AI themes with AI Infrastructure (SMH proxy) atop the rank list, a validated absolute-trend gate on for this market (gate_helps=true), and rotation breadth narrowing to 21/49 eligible names. Momentum rank itself has no return edge, so the note leans only on the trend-gate and my own durability judgement.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Semiconductor Equipment (WFE) can close the gap to AI Infrastructure in the rotation (margin 0.555): if WFE's score closes to within 0.3 of AI Infra while WFE's crowded flag clears toward 0.5, that would mark a confirmed leadership handoff worth reviewing; if WFE's score instead fades back below 1.4, the watch is retired.

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: This is the prevailing narrative with the highest rank and a high durability bar (0.73), broad internal breadth (0.875), and the absolute-trend gate is live (gate_helps=true, so staying-power discipline is the one validated edge). I lean with the dominant trend rather than fighting it, but the crowding flag (0.81) is a size-down caution only, not a reason to fade.
evidence: rank 1, score 2.253 and leader in rotation
eligible=true and benchmark is S&P 500 proxy SMH
theses.dissent: Cross-sectional momentum has rank-IC ~0 on clean sectors, so the high score is an attention lens, not evidence of future return; if the AI-infra narrative is already priced, the overweight earns nothing while carrying concentrated tech drawdown risk.

falsifier.text: SMH lags the S&P 500 by more than 5% total return over the next 20 trading days

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Highest durability score in the table (0.81), perfect breadth (1.0), and a strong trend tag while eligible and trend-gated. The crowding flag (1.91) is the highest on the board, so this is a direction lean with a clear size-down caution, not a full-throated endorsement.
theses.dissent: Crowding_z of 1.91 is the most extended in the universe; the guardrails explicitly warn that crowded themes are near-tops and should be capped, so chasing the strongest durability into the most crowded position risks buying late.

falsifier.text: CIBR fails to make a new 20-day high while the S&P 500 does

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: Third-ranked, trend-tagged, eligible, and not crowded (0.22). This is the least reflexive way to express the semiconductor leadership without the crowding of WFE (1.01) or the dominance of AI Infra itself.
theses.dissent: Breadth of only 0.5 is noticeably lower than peers, meaning the trend is carried by fewer names and the theme could be brittle if a single mover rolls over.

falsifier.text: SMH proxy of the memory theme breaks below its 50-day moving average
